newsitem.title: USA: IRS issues muni bond guide on doctor recruitment.
newsitem.headline: IRS issues muni bond guide on doctor recruitment.

text.p: The Internal Revenue Service on Monday issued final guidelines on when a hospital's strategy for recruiting or keeping doctors can threaten its tax-exempt status.
The guidelines, called Revenue Ruling 97-21, set out five different community scenarios and explain why the hospitals in four of the five situations would not face a loss of their tax exemption.

The issue surfaced in October 1995 when IRS announced that Hermann Hospital in Houston, Texas had agreed to pay it close to $1 million to settle charges that it violated federal standards for recruitment practices.
As a result of the "closing agreement" with IRS, the hospital was able to retain its tax-exempt status.
The hospital lured doctors with income guarantees and offers of free office space that did not require doctors to perform specific duties, such as responding to community needs.
